nodes.label: Next.js /api/* server-side proxy to BACKEND_URL (route.ts)
nodes.rationale: Blocks . and .. and always prefixes /api/, so it cannot be pointed at other servers or paths.

nodes.label: apple-design skill (WWDC fluid-interface guidance)
nodes.rationale: Spring bounce only for gesture-driven motion; remove bounce from segmented pill and theme icon.

nodes.label: Environment constraints (broken venv, offline PyPI, low memory, shared ports)
nodes.norm_label: environment constraints (broken venv, offline pypi, low memory, shared ports)
nodes.rationale: Call venv python by full path; pip-audit/bandit unavailable offline; check free -m before next dev/build; use ports 3021 and 8021-8049.

nodes.label: Finding 3: backend port published to host, /docs exposed (High)
nodes.norm_label: finding 3: backend port published to host, /docs exposed (high)
nodes.rationale: ports 8020:8000 lets callers skip the proxy; remove or bind to 127.0.0.1 and disable docs_url/redoc_url/openapi_url in production.

nodes.label: Finding 1: booking store exhaustion via MAX_ROWS (High)
nodes.norm_label: finding 1: booking store exhaustion via max_rows (high)
nodes.rationale: No rate limit, no per-phone limit and reservations never expire, so ~10,000 POSTs make every later booking fail with slot_full and leads fail with 429.

nodes.label: Finding 8: containers not hardened (Medium)
nodes.rationale: Add read_only, cap_drop ALL, no-new-privileges, mem_limit, pids_limit and tmpfs for the frontend cache.

nodes.label: Finding 13: cross-site JSON fetch CSRF gap (Low)
nodes.norm_label: finding 13: cross-site json fetch csrf gap (low)
nodes.rationale: Plain form POST already 422s; reject POSTs with Sec-Fetch-Site cross-site or mismatched Origin in the proxy.

nodes.label: Finding 6: missing security headers and CSP (Medium)
nodes.norm_label: finding 6: missing security headers and csp (medium)
nodes.rationale: Nonce-based CSP forces dynamic rendering and costs performance, so start with Content-Security-Policy-Report-Only; add headers in next.config.ts and --no-server-header to uvicorn.

nodes.label: Finding 12: personal data collected with no privacy notice (Low)
nodes.norm_label: finding 12: personal data collected with no privacy notice (low)
nodes.rationale: Names and phones are memory-only and no endpoint reads them, so it is a product gap as well as a privacy one.

nodes.label: Finding 2: proxy hides real client IP (High)
nodes.norm_label: finding 2: proxy hides real client ip (high)
nodes.rationale: All requests arrive from the frontend container; set x-forwarded-for in the proxy and run uvicorn with --proxy-headers --forwarded-allow-ips limited to the trusted hop.

nodes.label: Finding 5: proxy has no backend timeout (Medium)
nodes.norm_label: finding 5: proxy has no backend timeout (medium)
nodes.rationale: Use AbortSignal.any([req.signal, AbortSignal.timeout(8000)]) and return 504.

nodes.label: Finding 7: reservation code collisions with token_hex(3) (Medium)
nodes.norm_label: finding 7: reservation code collisions with token_hex(3) (medium)
nodes.rationale: 16.7M codes gives ~95% collision chance at 10,000 reservations; older reservation silently lost while its seat stays taken.

nodes.label: Finding 4: no request body size limit (Medium)
nodes.norm_label: finding 4: no request body size limit (medium)
nodes.rationale: Proxy reads whole body with req.text(); reject over ~8 KB with 413, cap chunked bodies while reading, mirror in a FastAPI middleware. Rejecting early is cheaper than parsing.

nodes.label: Finding 9: unpinned base images and unhashed wheels (Medium)
nodes.norm_label: finding 9: unpinned base images and unhashed wheels (medium)
nodes.rationale: Pin python:3.12-slim and node:24-alpine by digest, add hashes to requirements.txt with --require-hashes, ignore .env* files.

nodes.label: Iran Supercharge Network app
nodes.rationale: FastAPI backend with in-memory data and simulated charger states; Next.js 16 / React 19 fa/en RTL frontend with landing, booking sheet and investor dashboard.

nodes.label: Perf 20: landing page is entirely a client component
nodes.norm_label: perf 20: landing page is entirely a client component

nodes.label: Perf 19: heavy GPU blur effects on mid-range Android
nodes.norm_label: perf 19: heavy gpu blur effects on mid-range android
nodes.rationale: Keep backdrop blur only for nav, tab bar and sheet; nearly solid cards also follow Apple guidance against stacking translucent layers.

nodes.label: Perf 16: /api/network recomputed per request (cache per 15 s tick)
nodes.norm_label: perf 16: /api/network recomputed per request (cache per 15 s tick)
nodes.rationale: 60 seeded random.Random objects per poll while states only change every 15 s; cache per tick with a small dict or lru_cache(maxsize=2).

nodes.label: Perf 17: API JSON not compressed (GZipMiddleware, cache-control)
nodes.norm_label: perf 17: api json not compressed (gzipmiddleware, cache-control)

nodes.label: Perf 18: polling never backs off after errors
nodes.norm_label: perf 18: polling never backs off after errors

nodes.label: Next-session remediation plan (section 7)
nodes.rationale: One assert-style regression test per backend fix, small diffs, no new dependencies, retest attacks with bounded load (<=50 concurrent, <=3,000 total).

nodes.rationale: Lightning bolt signals EV supercharging; cyan-to-mint-to-lime gradient (#00e0ff, #3dffa8, #c6ff3d) on near-black #030507 matches the dark aurora visual theme.

nodes.rationale: Next 16 has breaking API and convention changes vs. training data; block is auto-regenerated by next dev (generate-agent-files.js).

nodes.label: In-memory state requires a single uvicorn worker
nodes.norm_label: in-memory state requires a single uvicorn worker
nodes.rationale: State lives in memory, so a second worker would break booking counts; use --limit-concurrency and --timeout-keep-alive 5 instead of scaling workers.

nodes.label: Per-IP rate limiter (dict of IP to deque of timestamps inside existing lock)
nodes.norm_label: per-ip rate limiter (dict of ip to deque of timestamps inside existing lock)
nodes.rationale: O(1) per request and no new dependency; combined with expiring past-slot reservations and max 2 active reservations per phone.
